promise: Repository signals select the standards that matter, and every resulting finding retains its pack, rule, scope, and coverage context.

mechanism.label: Read repository signals
mechanism.detail: Quality Runner derives relevance signals from the codebase instead of applying every available standard indiscriminately.

mechanism.label: Select the relevant packs
mechanism.detail: Eight of twelve eligible packs were selected for the July 17 Tenure baseline.

mechanism.label: Evaluate scoped rules
mechanism.detail: Deterministic rules and review obligations evaluate only the files and patterns owned by each standard.

mechanism.label: Keep provenance attached
mechanism.detail: The scan records pack, rule, evidence, scoped-file coverage, matched files, and finding count.

mechanism.label: Review before changing code
mechanism.detail: Findings become source fixes, source-evidenced dispositions, or unresolved work; a raw row is never automatically a defect.

customization_model.automatic_default: relevant packs are selected from repository signals
customization_model.owner_control: owners may change selection mode, active packs, local skills, path scope, rules, thresholds, and scan exclusions
customization_model.why_it_matters: two repositories can run the same engine while being judged against different definitions of quality

agent_reconciliation_model.relationship: Quality Runner supplies the evidence, stable fingerprints, remediation context, and resolution ledger; a reviewing agent investigates source and proposes or records the evidence-backed outcome.

outcomes.meaning: source changed and focused proof showed the finding cleared
the detected pattern is an intentional tradeoff whose owner, reason, evidence, and optional expiry remain visible
source evidence shows the detector row does not represent actionable debt, so the disposition is preserved instead of silently suppressing the row
the evidence still supports actionable or unresolved work

agent_reconciliation_model.terminal_interpretation: The 537 retained rows were still raw detector output, but the historical ledger had reconciled their meaning and recorded 0 open actionable findings.

value_execution_loop.customer_promise: The same standards that guide agent output and execution can become the quality contract used to inspect what those agents produce.

stages.label: Your standard
stages.title: Name what good looks like
stages.detail: Skills, guides, and agent rules express the output quality and execution behavior your team values.

stages.label: Prevented outcome
stages.title: Make the failure explicit
stages.detail: Reviewed ingest identifies the concrete negatives behind the instruction: generic copy, missing states, unsafe boundaries, or other unwanted patterns.

stages.label: Checkable contract
stages.title: Choose how to inspect it
stages.detail: Low-noise standards become deterministic rules; judgment-heavy standards become bounded agent-review rubrics.

stages.label: Concrete findings
stages.title: Measure the gap in the repo
stages.detail: Each result retains its skill, rule, file, line, evidence, severity, scope, and coverage instead of becoming an anonymous warning.

stages.label: Remediation plan
stages.title: Turn debt into bounded work
stages.detail: Group findings by standard, risk, and surface; remediate in small slices and verify against the same value that created the finding.

tenure_example.label: Value
tenure_example.value: Interfaces should feel intentional, legible, and complete

tenure_example.label: Prevent
tenure_example.value: Generic UI, unclear states, and structural design shortcuts

tenure_example.label: Plan
tenure_example.value: Scoped findings grouped into reviewable remediation slices

value_execution_loop.boundary: A supervising ingest agent may propose a conservative pack from a Skill, guide, or preference document; a human reviews it; Quality Runner validates the non-executable pack and records its exact version and content hash. Quality Runner does not execute arbitrary Skill code or silently invent rules during a scan.
